news.headline: UTSA beats Tulane 42-19
news.summary: Tulane lost at home Saturday night. UTSA ran for five touchdowns, and Tulane is now 3-4.

news.headline: Anthony Rogers scores on the first play of the game
news.summary: Rogers intercepted a UTSA pass on the first play from scrimmage Saturday and ran it back 22 yards for a touchdown. He had two interceptions in the game, but UTSA scored the next 28 points.

news.headline: Kevin Adams III wins a conference award
news.summary: Adams had nine tackles, two interceptions and a fumble recovery in Friday's win over Memphis. The American Conference named him its best defensive player of the week on Monday.

nextGame.note: Florida plays Georgia in Atlanta on Halloween afternoon. Half past two our time. Georgia is ranked third in the country and has won six games and lost one.

news.headline: Florida moves up to No. 17
news.summary: The Gators were off on Saturday and still moved up three spots in the Associated Press Top 25, from 20th to 17th. They play third-ranked Georgia in Atlanta on Saturday.

news.headline: LJ McCray wins an award for the Texas game
news.summary: McCray had a career-best one and a half sacks and four tackles in Saturday's win at Texas. The SEC named him its defensive lineman of the week on Monday.

news.headline: Florida beats Texas 27-24
news.summary: Florida was losing 17-3 in the second quarter and then scored 24 points in a row to win in Austin. The Gators are 5-2, and it is their first win at a top-10 team on the road since 2012.

nextGame.note: Saturday night home game in Austin. Half past six our time. Mississippi State has won four games and lost three.

news.headline: Texas climbs to No. 11
news.summary: Beating seventh-ranked Ole Miss moved Texas up eight spots in the Associated Press Top 25, from 19th to 11th. Texas has won five games and lost two.

news.headline: Texas beats Ole Miss 34-27
news.summary: Texas led by 21 points and then let Ole Miss tie the game, but Arch Manning ran for the winning touchdown in the fourth quarter Saturday night in Austin. Ole Miss threw one last pass into the end zone and Texas intercepted it.

news.headline: Arch Manning will keep starting at quarterback
news.summary: Coach Steve Sarkisian said Monday that Manning is still his starter and that Manning can play better for them. Texas has lost two games in a row.

nextGame.note: Sunday morning game in Paris, France. Half past eight our time. The Saints lost 16-10. They are off next Sunday, and their next game is at home against Cleveland on November 8.

news.headline: Steelers beat the Saints 16-10 in Paris
news.summary: The Saints lost Sunday morning at Stade de France, in the first National Football League game ever played in France. They ran for only 18 yards all day, and they are now 2-5.

news.headline: An interception in the red zone turns the game
news.summary: The Saints had driven to the Pittsburgh 10-yard line in the third quarter when Tyler Shough's pass was intercepted by Payton Wilson. Pittsburgh kicked a field goal on the next drive, and the Saints did not score again.

news.headline: Daniel Carlson misses from 52 yards
news.summary: The Saints kicker missed a field goal in the fourth quarter with his team down six points. It was his fourth miss in 11 tries this season.

news.headline: IUP wins twice at home and is 18-4
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks beat Clarion on Friday and Slippery Rock on Saturday, both in four sets. They have won six matches in a row and sit first in their half of the conference.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher helps block three balls against Clarion
news.summary: Peyton played three of the four sets in Friday's win over Clarion and was in on three blocks. She had 3 kills on 14 swings with 4 errors.

news.headline: Delaney Concannon gets her 1,000th career dig
news.summary: Concannon needed five digs to reach 1,000 and finished Friday's win over Clarion with 20. She also led IUP with 18 kills.

news.headline: Three Yankees are up for a Gold Glove
news.summary: Catcher Austin Wells, left fielder Cody Bellinger and Jose Caballero were named finalists for this year's fielding awards on Wednesday. The winners are announced on November 1.

news.headline: Tampa Bay beats the Yankees 4-3 and ends their season
news.summary: Tampa Bay won Wednesday night at Yankee Stadium to take the series three games to none. The Yankees are out of the playoffs, and it is 17 years since they last won the World Series.

news.headline: Aaron Judge says the Yankees should go all in
news.summary: Judge strained a calf in September and watched the whole playoff series from the dugout. He said afterward that the team should go all in and add players for next year.
